name: Aspen/Pitkin County Airport
description: Aspen/Pitkin County Airport serves Aspen at about 7,838 feet, with a night curfew and a 2027 runway closure. Mountain performance and the attended day belong in the charter plan.

sections.heading: Choosing your arrival
paragraphs: Start with the resort or residence, the travel date, and the latest useful arrival. Aspen/Pitkin County (ASE / KASE) is a high-altitude mountain airport, not a suburban field with spare runway. Tell EXJET whether you can leave earlier, travel the previous day, or accept Eagle County, Rifle, or Grand Junction and the drive that follows.

sections.heading: Runway, elevation, and the 2027 closure
paragraphs: Elevation is about 7,838 feet. Runway 15/33 is published as 8,006 by 100 feet, with 7,006 feet of landing distance available in both directions because of a displaced threshold on runway 33 and reduced takeoff distances on runway 15. The airport states a 95-foot wingspan limit. FAA remarks warn of terrain and recommend a performance review. These figures are from the FAA display effective 29 October 2026 through 26 November 2026.

The airport is scheduled to close for runway reconstruction from 11:00 p.m. on 4 April 2027 through 7:00 p.m. on 19 November 2027. The 2026–27 ski season can still use ASE. During the closure, the alternates to discuss are EGE, Rifle (RIL), and Grand Junction (GJT), with a ground transfer. After the project the runway is planned to widen and the wingspan limit is planned to rise. Confirm the current notice before you plan summer 2027 or the start of the 2027–28 season.

sections.heading: Curfew and the private terminal
paragraphs: The field is closed 2300–0700 MST. Attendance is 0700–2300, there are no departures after 2230 MST, and Stage I operations are prohibited. Night general aviation has additional equipment and experience rules. Atlantic Aviation at 69 East Airport Road is the FBO named in public sources. Confirm hours, the two-hour staging notice, and holiday ramp limits for your dates. Give the driver that street address, not the airline terminal.

sections.heading: What to include in your request
paragraphs: Send the dates, the Dallas-area departure airport, the passenger count, and a separate list of skis, boards, and bags. State the return window and what can move if weather or the curfew closes the arrival. Ask for the written trip total before you confirm. The operator, not the aircraft name, decides whether the flight can be flown.

faqs.question: Where do I meet my charter flight at LAS?
faqs.answer: Use the FBO and street address confirmed by the aircraft operator. Private aircraft may be handled separately from the airline terminal; share the confirmed instructions with your driver.

faqs.question: Can every business jet use this airport?
faqs.answer: No aircraft is guaranteed suitable from its category or runway length alone. The operating carrier must check aircraft performance, payload, weather, restrictions and required permissions for the flight.

name: Chicago Midway International Airport
description: Chicago Midway supports both airline and general aviation activity. Its published FBO facilities provide a starting point for arranging business jet arrivals, meetings and onward ground transport in Chicago.

sections.heading: Choosing your arrival
paragraphs: Specify the office, hotel or venue rather than requesting a generic Chicago arrival. Compare the overall transfer with other suitable area airports if the destination is outside the city. An aircraft’s arrival time and the time you reach the meeting should remain separate commitments.

sections.heading: Private terminal and ground transfer
paragraphs: Chicago’s airport authority lists Atlantic Aviation and Signature at Midway. Obtain the specific facility address from the operator and circulate it to every traveler. A rideshare destination set to the airline terminal may take passengers to the wrong side of the airport.

sections.heading: Schedule and operating considerations
paragraphs: Discuss deicing, weather delays and the return window when planning a winter itinerary. If the group is returning after an evening event, have the operator assess crew duty and aircraft parking. A same-day round trip needs a complete proposal covering both sectors.

sections.heading: What to include in your request
paragraphs: Send the dates, departure airport, passenger count and full baggage list. State whether you need catering, connectivity, mobility support or a return flight on the same aircraft. Ask for the complete written trip price and the conditions for any change before confirming.

name: William P. Hobby Airport
description: William P. Hobby Airport is a Houston airport option for business jet charter. Select the airport and FBO around your Houston destination, the proposed aircraft and the complete ground journey.

sections.heading: Choosing your arrival
paragraphs: Houston covers a large area. Send the meeting, industrial site or residence address before choosing an arrival airport. Hobby may be worth comparing for a southern or central destination, while a different airport could suit a northern itinerary better.

sections.heading: Private terminal and ground transfer
paragraphs: Private charter travelers should use the operator-confirmed handling facility. Arrange a vehicle sized for the passengers and equipment, and ask how the driver will meet the group. This matters particularly when a trip includes presentation materials or specialist business equipment.

sections.heading: Schedule and operating considerations
paragraphs: For a short Dallas–Houston mission, positioning and minimum charges may represent a larger part of the price than the occupied flight. State the expected meeting duration and whether the return is firm. Compare the complete same-day itinerary with separate one-way proposals.

sections.heading: What to include in your request
paragraphs: Send the dates, departure airport, passenger count and full baggage list. State whether you need catering, connectivity, mobility support or a return flight on the same aircraft. Ask for the complete written trip price and the conditions for any change before confirming.

name: Los Cabos International Airport
city: San José del Cabo / Los Cabos
description: Los Cabos International Airport uses SJD / MMSD and serves San José del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas. It is distinct from Cabo San Lucas International Airport, so the exact airport should be explicit in a charter request.
location: San José del Cabo / Los Cabos

sections.heading: Choosing your arrival
paragraphs: Give the resort or residence address and confirm whether the proposal uses Los Cabos International or another approved airport. Do not send a driver to an airport based only on the word Cabo. Include enough transfer time for the actual arrival facility and destination.

sections.heading: Private terminal and ground transfer
paragraphs: The airport operator publishes a private aviation/FBO service for SJD. Have the aircraft operator confirm handling, customs, immigration and any operating permissions for your itinerary. Submit passenger documentation through the agreed secure channel and use names exactly as shown on travel documents.

sections.heading: Schedule and operating considerations
paragraphs: The return to the United States needs its own clearance and arrival plan. Confirm the approved U.S. arrival airport, passenger details and any pet arrangements well before departure. Charter price comparisons should include international handling and applicable charges rather than only flight hours.

sections.heading: What to include in your request
paragraphs: Send the dates, departure airport, passenger count and full baggage list. State whether you need catering, connectivity, mobility support or a return flight on the same aircraft. Ask for the complete written trip price and the conditions for any change before confirming.
